Ayman et al., Journal of Chemistry (2023)
Bayat/El Attar et al., Int. J. Hydrogen Energy (2023)

AOR_Pd.note: Pd is especially active for AOR in alkaline media

CV_parameters.note: Very active in alkaline — low onset potential

AOR_PtRu.note: Bifunctional mechanism — Ru provides OH for CO oxidation

CV_parameters.note: Much better CO tolerance than Pt alone

AOR_PtSn.note: Sn promotes C-C bond cleavage in ethanol oxidation

AOR_PdAu.note: Au modifies Pd electronic structure; excellent alkaline activity

AOR_PdNi.note: Ni promotes OH adsorption in alkaline media

AOR_NiCo.note: Non-precious bimetallic — cost-effective for alkaline AOR

CV_parameters.product_note: Short chain -> aldehydes; long chain -> carboxylic acids

AOR_Pt_graphene.note: Graphene support enhances electron transfer and Pt dispersion

CV_parameters.note: Lower onset than Pt/C due to better Pt dispersion

AOR_Pd_graphene.note: Excellent alkaline AOR; graphene prevents Pd agglomeration

CV_parameters.note: Among best performance for alkaline ethanol oxidation

AOR_Pt_C.note: Standard benchmark catalyst; carbon support improves dispersion

AOR_N_graphene.note: N-doping creates active sites; enhances metal-support interaction

AOR_gC3N4.note: Graphitic carbon nitride; high N content; semiconductor support; visible light active

alkaline.note: Two arcs: high-f = charge transfer, low-f = semiconductor/support

AOR_MXene.note: 2D transition metal carbide; metallic conductivity; abundant surface terminations

EIS_parameters.note: MXene has very high double-layer capacitance

AOR_NP_graphene.note: Co-doping with N and P creates stronger active sites; better than single-doped

AOR_NiCoFe_LDH.note: Layered double hydroxide — excellent alkaline activity; CO-tolerant

AOR_PtCu.note: Cu compressive strain lowers Pt activation barrier; methanol has lowest electron-transfer energy barrier

CV_parameters.reference: Bayat et al., 2023, Int. J. Hydrogen Energy

AOR_PtRh_SnO2.note: Rh promotes C-C bond cleavage; SnO2 provides oxygen species

CV_parameters.RDS: First electron transfer (Temkin isotherm); C-C bond cleavage

R0-p(R1,CPE1)-W1.name: Randles cell with Warburg
R0-p(R1,CPE1)-W1.interpretation: R0=electrolyte, R1=charge transfer, CPE=double layer, W=diffusion

R0-p(R1,CPE1)-p(R2,CPE2).name: Two time-constant model
R0-p(R1,CPE1)-p(R2,CPE2).interpretation: Two overlapping processes (e.g. charge transfer + adsorption/film)

R0-p(R1,CPE1)-p(R2,CPE2)-W1.name: Two time-constant with Warburg diffusion
R0-p(R1,CPE1)-p(R2,CPE2)-W1.interpretation: SEI + charge transfer + diffusion (batteries); or two reactions + diffusion
R0-p(R1,CPE1)-p(R2,CPE2)-W1.use_when: Battery systems; two arcs + 45 deg tail at low frequency

R0-p(CPE1-p(R1-p(Cp,Rp))).name: Adsorbed intermediate inductive loop model
R0-p(CPE1-p(R1-p(Cp,Rp))).interpretation: Cp/Rp branch captures delayed relaxation of CO_ads; produces inductive arc at intermediate potentials
R0-p(CPE1-p(R1-p(Cp,Rp))).use_when: Pt/C in H2SO4; visible inductive loop at intermediate potential; CO poisoning
R0-p(CPE1-p(R1-p(Cp,Rp))).reference: Otomo et al., 2004, J. Electroanal. Chem.

carbon_materials._description: Carbon supports and pure carbon electrodes used in AOR research

Vulcan_XC72R.cv_behavior: Featureless double-layer; no H/O adsorption peaks
Vulcan_XC72R.functionalization: As-received or thermally treated 600 degC in N2/H2
Vulcan_XC72R.reference: Teran-Salgado et al., 2019; Almeida et al., 2019

CNT_MWCNT.performance_vs_carbon_black: 1.8x higher ethanol oxidation rate for Pd/MWCNT
CNT_MWCNT.cv_redox_features: Broad quinone redox peaks from -COOH/-OH after acid oxidation
CNT_MWCNT.reference: Wang et al., 2019; Maxakato et al., 2024; Tiempos, 2018

rGO.reference: Yellatur et al., 2022; Fu et al., 2023

CNO.advantage: O moieties act as anchoring points; better stability than carbon black

preparation.cleaning: Ultrasonic in DI water or ethanol

GC.reference: Brix et al., 2022; Oh et al., 2023

GO.cv_redox: Irreversible reduction at ~-700 mV vs Ag/AgCl

H2O2_oxidation.effect: Enhances OH- access; improves electron transfer to Pt-Cu

N_doping.mechanism: Positive charge density on C atoms -> alcohol adsorption site

B_doping.mechanism: Lewis acid site; facilitates OH- adsorption; weakens CO on metals
B_doping.reference: Yang, 2019 cited in Fu et al., 2023

Cdl.description: Double-layer capacitance from scan rate dependence

electrode_preparation_GC.cleaning: Ultrasonic in DI water or ethanol
